selection_basis: Four authentic open-access studies selected independently of PCS extractor/checker outputs; one development and three final cases. Original published code/data plus a separately identified curated PEtab representation. Exact source bytes frozen before final evaluation.

recovery.reason: Execution environment restart erased prior uncommitted RAM source freeze and artifacts; no frozen final evaluations had run.
recovery.differences: New acquisition timestamps and dynamic ZIP containers; portable source inclusion explicitly reconstructed rather than claiming byte identity with unavailable prior selection. constraints.final_access: Heldout sources stored outside checkout; materialize requires allow_final=True; developers must not read before software freeze.
